scope: Four amulets and five seals, including the legacy seal subclass. Existing world sprites use the tier-one image for all qualities; inventory tier-two/tier-three icons remain unchanged.
dimensions_note: Authoring coordinates trace existing 128-pixel artwork. Thickness and tessellation are presentation-only; uniform fitting remains within the prior opaque width/height. Native Actor.Scale .275, collision, mass and equipment rules remain unchanged.
modularity: Separate closed editable pendant backs, painted reliefs, raised gems/emblems and independent chain/suspension links. These are world props, not fitted character wearables.
projection_note: Original decorative pixels project over the full raised surface. An opaque closed metal backing keeps internal source-image transparency from opening the prop; ring interiors remain genuinely open geometry. Metal backs and links use the unchanged owned #647 painted bronze, silver and gold atlas tiles. Raised emblem/gem layers also have an opaque closed undercoat sampling their own unchanged image. This prevents semitransparent painted highlights from exposing a contrasting metal star in the center. The undercoat samples a bright fully opaque highlight from inside its own gem/emblem, preserving the intended light appearance of source pixels whose alpha is zero.
